title: Polymer Intelligence — Архитектура базы данных (Database Architecture)
summary: PostgreSQL 16 database architecture with concrete DDL for the polymer market intelligence platform: raw ingest, normalized signals, requests, price points, alerts, reports.
notes: Dominant signals are concrete CREATE TABLE/TYPE DDL, data models, and a screen→data mapping table → SPEC (implementation contracts). Document records locked architectural/schema decisions and design principles but lacks ADR structure (no Context/Decision/Consequences sections, no Status: Accepted marker), so classified as SPEC rather than ADR. Russian-language source; title/summary rendered partly in English. Version history (v1.0/v1.1) present.
